title: Single Row Asscher
subtitle: A single line of Asschers, corner to corner, moving on the Flex.

stone.origin: Natural. Asscher diamonds set corner-to-corner in a single row. 6.5 to 8.5 inch.

description: A single line of Asscher-cut diamonds set corner to corner along the patented Bez Ambar Flex, engineered to move freely with the wrist. The Asscher pulls the eye downward into its stepped, concentric depth; run in one continuous row, that depth repeats along the wrist as a line of small, deep windows of light. Because the Flex carries no hinge or clasp, the row pours around the arm and shifts with the hand rather than sitting rigid. Made in eighteen-karat gold or platinum, to fit.
